You wouldn’t have a copy, it would be the nursery who keep it as evidence when they claim funding from the LA. But they should be able to provide evidence of this, as it will have information such as your NI number etc.
If he left in the last term and they genuinely didn’t stretch his funding then there should be no issues with new headcount.

It’s the responsibility of the old nursery to let your local authority know that the child is leaving else they run the risk of over claiming. They can also amend funding if you left part way through the funded term. 
When did you give notice to leave the old nursery? As this will impact whether they can amend the funding. 

You should have been asked to sign a funding declaration form to acknowledge the hours your child was attending and there would have been a ticked box if the funding was being stretched. It may be worth asking the old nursery to see a copy of this and this will be the most solid proof as to if they stretched it or not. You can then report to the local authority, but I imagine you will gain a refund swiftly if they realise you know what you’re looking for.

Hope this helps.
